name: Marchel Industries
description: Marchel Industries is a full service plastic injection molding and machining facility located in Spartanburg, SC. Our 35,000 square foot climate controlled facility is equipped with state of the art injection molding and CNC machining equipment and is ready to take on your 20 – 400 ton press injection molding project. In addition to full service plastic injection molding, our capabilities include precision machining, EDM machining, plastic design, custom molding, reverse engineering, prototyping, parts assembly, testing, and dimensional analysis. ISO 9001:2015 certified, we are committed to quality and excellent customer service in all industries that we serve, including OEM, medical, government, military and industrial. Contact us today for a quote on your next injection molding or machining project.
